items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 September 2026 4:11pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 12 September 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Flat ridge of high pressure and weak frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the east, quickly veering north or northwest 2 to 4 and variable overnight and tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, quickly settling south or southwest 3 or 4, increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then areas of mist and isolated fog patches soon developing. Rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, soon becoming moderate or poor and falling very poor in fog patches.
